About Role

Apex's IMPACT early career program for new grads who refuse to settle for ordinary.

As a Product Management IMPACT participant, you'll join a cohort of new grads on a year-long journey built to fast-track you from talented graduate to fintech product leader—through intensive training, executive mentorship, and high-visibility projects.

The Basics: Begins July 2027 | In-office 4 days/week in Austin, Dallas, New York, or Chicago (Relocation Assistance Available)

What To Expect

Kick off with a 6-week immersive onboarding (AI/Claude training, fintech product fundamentals, and Apex culture)
Shape AI-powered product features and use AI tools to move from idea to launch faster
Join your home team as a core contributor, owning product initiatives that impact users and business outcomes
Lead strategic initiatives across product innovation, UX, and go-to-market
Build your brand through hackathons and product innovation challenges
Get continuous mentorship from IMPACT alumni who have successfully navigated the program

Why It's Worth It

Real work from day one. You are an owner, not an observer
Direct executive access through monthly 1:1s
Dedicated time to build AI-powered projects that actually ship, not just experiments
A clear path forward. We're building future leaders, not permanent analysts
A cohort and alumni network that opens doors for life
Tech & tools: JIRA
 Claude
 Claude Code
 Confluence
 Monday.com
 Python/R
 AWS or GCP
 AI development tools

What We're Looking For

Available to start July 2027 alongside your IMPACT cohort
Bachelor's in Business Administration, MIS, Informatics & Systems, Finance, Product
Management, Computer Science, or related field
Typically 3.0+ GPA (exceptional candidates with strong leadership encouraged to apply).
Demonstrated product leadership through internships, strategic projects, or initiatives
Strong analytical skills; a strategic thinker who thrives in ambiguity and complex user needs
Strong communicator who can influence at all levels and convey complex ideas clearly
Genuine curiosity about fintech and building innovative financial products
Eligible to work in the US without employer sponsorship

www.apexfintechsolutions.com

Why Apex?

While other programs offer rotations and observations, IMPACT offers transformation. You'll tackle product challenges that would take years to access elsewhere, present solutions to executives who implement your ideas, and build a portfolio that distinguishes you for life. We're not looking for perfect resumes—we're looking for future product leaders.

Pay Range: $70,160 - $87,700
